children: Portugal's government on Wednesday picked Lufthansa

to acquire a 44.9% stake in TAP Air Portugal for €1.2 billion ($1.34 billion), making the German airline the strategic partner of one of Europe's last unaligned flag carriers, Prime Minister Luis Montenegro told a news briefing.

Lufthansa, which already owns Austrian Airlines, ITA Airways and SWISS,  beat rival Air France-KLM after both airlines submitted improved final bids in late September. Montenegro said the winning bid exceeded Air France-KLM's offer by 16%.
